title: For those who like cycling or have no issues, a must-do
text: Truly very beautiful and interesting. Paolo, our guide, gave us a very in-depth summary of Seville and its main monuments! A must-do!
author: MATTEO_B

title: To do at the beginning of the stay with Sébastien as a guide, it provides a good overview of the city (history & neighbo
text:
A good activity to discover the monuments to see and visit in Seville!
We recommend Sébastien as a guide; he is very available and adapts to our requests, making our exchanges interesting.
author: Laurent_M

title: Quickly go discover the city by bike.
text:
A very beautiful bike tour that allows one to get to know the city. 
A wonderful guide who teaches us a lot of things, including the history of the city.
author: Eric_L

title: Amazing tour guide and...
text: Amazing tour guide and group. Best way to experience the city with quick overview of main sights and attractions while exercising
author: mohammeds

title: Inspiring and beautifully paced bike tour
text: We had a inspiring and informative bike tour with our guide Garic. Gently paced to suit our interests. His love of the city shines through. Highly recommended.
author: wendysD9216KI

title: Best bike tour to see best of Sevilla
text: Amazing experience! We were 3 adults and a 3 year old. No other groups showed up, so it ended up feeling like a private tour. We have two other kids 8 and 6, and after going on the tour I am happy we did not have them ride along. I would say experience riding in a street, along tight quarters, and through traffic would be needed for kids. All the sights and information we learned makes this totally worth it. You will feel like you saw all the best of Sevilla, feeling less sad if you are unable to  go back and go inside any of the highlights.
author: Ashley_V

title: A perfect guided walk
text: Our guide Sarai was perfect, we travelled the streets of Seville with her with pleasure. His topos on the history and monuments of Seville were very interesting and perfectly suited for adults and children alike (4-12 years old)
author: Cecile_C

title: Fab tour - lovely,...
text:
Fab tour - lovely, friendly and informative guide - highly recommend!
2.5hrs with a couple of opportunities to hop off and have a walk around.
author: Laura_L

title: Great way to see Seville....
text: Great way to see Seville. Excellent first day tour. Perfect amount of time and nicely positioned stopping spots for a bit of history from our guide.
